n3f5e469a67.headline: Trump suspends US foreign assistance for 90 days pending reviews
n3f5e469a67.summary: President Trump has suspended US foreign assistance for 90 days, with all foreign funds shelved pending reviews of whether they align with his policy goals.
n3f5e469a67.why: Foreign aid flows affect recipient economies and US budget spending, and policy shifts can alter trade and diplomatic relations.

n69d5e8d2c4.headline: Trump's Tariff Strategy: 25% Import Tax on Canada and Mexico by February 1
n69d5e8d2c4.summary: President Trump has unveiled a plan to impose 25% tariffs on imports from Canada and Mexico starting in February.
n69d5e8d2c4.why: Canada and Mexico are the largest trading partners of the US in North America, so tariffs on their goods affect supply chains, prices and currencies across the region.
n69d5e8d2c4.why_moved: The plan to impose 25% tariffs on imports from Canada and Mexico raises the prospect of higher trade costs for North American supply chains.

na64b73da3e.headline: After two years of smooth sailing, Fed ready to navigate rocky bond market, Trump uncertainty
na64b73da3e.summary: The Federal Reserve meets next week with attention on new Trump administration policies and a bond market that has raised borrowing costs even as the Fed has been cutting rates.
na64b73da3e.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, and its policy path affects borrowing costs, bond yields and equity valuations worldwide.

n4568cbff2e.headline: Donald Trump signals 25 per cent tariffs on Canadian imports could be coming Feb. 1
n4568cbff2e.summary: US President Donald Trump suggested his administration could move ahead with 25% across-the-board tariffs on Canadian imports on Feb. 1. The signal raises the prospect of a new trade dispute with Canada.
n4568cbff2e.why: Canada is the largest trading partner of the United States, so across-the-board tariffs would affect a broad range of cross-border trade and corporate supply chains.
n4568cbff2e.why_moved: Trump suggested the tariffs could take effect Feb. 1, raising the prospect of new trade barriers on Canadian goods. Tariff threats of this kind typically weigh on exporters and the Canadian currency.

n894543a20a.headline: January 21: $1 trades at GHS16.20 on Forex Bureaus, GHS15.41 average rate
n894543a20a.summary: The Ghanaian cedi has depreciated against the US dollar, with $1 trading at GHS16.20 on forex bureaus on January 21. The average rate was GHS15.41.
n894543a20a.why: The cedi's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and the value of dollar-denominated debt for Ghana. Forex bureau rates are a key gauge of local currency pressure.

impacts.name: Ghanaian cedi
impacts.why: The cedi has depreciated against the US dollar in the forex bureau market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nef1b2aecb3.headline: Stock exchange, stop no-limit orders on Netweek
nef1b2aecb3.summary: Borsa Italiana said no limit order entry will be allowed on Netweek ordinary shares from Wednesday, January 22. Netweek's stock closed up 26 percent on the preceding Tuesday.
nef1b2aecb3.why: Borsa Italiana operates Italy's main stock exchange, and order-entry rules are used to manage trading in volatile small-cap shares.

n08511a419e.headline: HUB Security Announces Receipt of Staff Delisting Notice
n08511a419e.summary: HUB Cyber Security announced it received a Nasdaq staff delisting notice. The Tel Aviv-based company is a cybersecurity and data fabric provider listed under the ticker HUBC.
n08511a419e.why: A Nasdaq delisting notice signals a compliance problem that can lead to removal from the exchange, affecting liquidity and access to US capital for shareholders.

n2fc5491474.headline: Bain Capital in Talks to Buy Mitsubishi Tanabe Pharma -- Update
n2fc5491474.summary: Bain Capital is in talks to acquire the pharmaceutical business of Mitsubishi Chemical Group in a potential multibillion-dollar deal, a person familiar with the matter said.
n2fc5491474.why: Mitsubishi Chemical Group is a Tokyo-based conglomerate, and Bain Capital is a large private equity firm that often takes control of businesses it acquires.

n990bd2434b.headline: Defence industry consultant RC Fornax plans February IPO on AIM
n990bd2434b.summary: RC Fornax plans to list on London's AIM junior market early next month, aiming to raise GBP5 million. The consultancy is focused on developing artificial intelligence products.
n990bd2434b.why: AIM is London's junior market for smaller growth companies, and small IPOs like this one carry higher risk and lower liquidity than main-market listings.

nd8b429ba92.headline: Share market update: Most active stocks of the day in terms of traded value
nd8b429ba92.summary: The NSE Nifty index closed 320.1 points lower at 23,024.65. The report also covers the most actively traded stocks by value.
nd8b429ba92.why: The Nifty 50 is the benchmark index of the National Stock Exchange of India, tracking the country's largest listed companies.
nd8b429ba92.why_moved: The index closed 320.1 points down at 23,024.65, according to the market update.

n6d3536622c.headline: Fall in company collapses last year but experts warn of ongoing ‘headwinds’
n6d3536622c.summary: Company insolvencies fell last year compared with the prior year, but their number remains at levels last seen during the 2008 financial crisis. Experts warn of ongoing headwinds.
n6d3536622c.why: Insolvency counts are a gauge of corporate financial stress, which affects lenders, suppliers and credit markets.

n8251d2b079.headline: Trump’s Tariffs Could Hit Canadian Goods on February 1
n8251d2b079.summary: Tariffs on Canadian goods could take effect on February 1, according to reports. The threat comes as Donald Trump begins his second term in Washington.
n8251d2b079.why: Canada is one of the largest trading partners of the United States, so tariffs on its goods affect trade flows, exporters and the Canadian dollar.

nec0242d97d.headline: Trump orders US exit from Paris climate agreement and WHO
nec0242d97d.summary: The new US president signed a flurry of executive orders, including withdrawal from the Paris climate agreement and the World Health Organization. Some of the moves were more widely expected than others.
nec0242d97d.why: The Paris agreement shapes long-term climate policy that affects energy, industrial and clean-technology investment, and US policy shifts can alter global regulatory expectations.

nb8c9a744e3.headline: Brazil's Commercial Rentals Jump 7.88% in 2024, Outpacing Sales
nb8c9a744e3.summary: The FipeZap index shows Brazil's commercial rental prices rose 7.88% in 2024. The report describes a stark contrast with the commercial property sales market.
nb8c9a744e3.why: The FipeZap index is a widely used Brazilian benchmark for property prices and rents. Commercial real estate performance affects property companies, lenders and retail tenants.

n88420bca44.headline: Argentina Achieves Record Trade Surplus in 2024
n88420bca44.summary: Argentina's trade balance reached a historic high in 2024, with a surplus of $18.89 billion. The article attributes the result to a decrease in imports.
n88420bca44.why: Argentina is a major agricultural and commodity exporter, and its trade balance affects its foreign-currency reserves and peso outlook.

n4a301f1fef.headline: Finance minister says Trump's Feb. 1 tariff comments are 'nothing new'
n4a301f1fef.summary: Canadian Finance Minister Dominic LeBlanc said Donald Trump's suggestion of sweeping tariffs on Canada on Feb. 1 is nothing new. He said Canada has plans ready for several scenarios.
n4a301f1fef.why: Canada and the United States are each other's largest trading partners, so tariffs directly affect trade flows, the Canadian dollar and cross-border supply chains.

nd0795d931a.headline: 3M :  Press Release Q4 2024
nd0795d931a.summary: 3M reported fourth-quarter sales of $6.0 billion, up 0.1% year on year, and adjusted sales of $5.8 billion with 2.1% organic growth. The company also initiated full-year 2025 financial guidance.
nd0795d931a.why: 3M is a diversified US industrial conglomerate, and its quarterly results and guidance are closely watched as an indicator of industrial demand.

n7a9bbcec9d.headline: With rupee weak, what Indian expats in UAE can do ahead of next remittance
n7a9bbcec9d.summary: The rupee has dropped sharply, and India's central bank has not yet shown signs of intervening to halt the fall. Indian expats in the UAE are weighing the impact on their next remittance.
n7a9bbcec9d.why: The rupee's value sets the cost of imports and of dollar-denominated debt for India, and the RBI manages volatility through reserves and market operations.

source.name: Gulf News: Latest UAE news, Dubai news, Business, travel news, Dubai Gold rate,

sources.name: Gulf News: Latest UAE news, Dubai news, Business, travel news, Dubai Gold rate,

n7a9bbcec9d.why_moved: The article reports a steep rupee drop and no sign that the Reserve Bank of India has moved to halt it.

nb980c6d816.headline: Social media apps are changing how people buy and read books in China
nb980c6d816.summary: Social media apps are changing how people in China buy and read books, with discounts and influencer-driven trends gaining influence. Critics warn this may undermine the value of books.
nb980c6d816.why: Platform-driven retail shifts affect China's publishing and e-commerce businesses, where social commerce is a major channel for consumer spending.

n866543f804.headline: Global top bosses rank UK as second most attractive country for investment
n866543f804.summary: PwC's annual CEO survey ranks the UK as the second most attractive country for investment, ahead of Germany, China and India. PwC described it as a vote of confidence in the UK.
n866543f804.why: PwC's CEO survey gathers views from global chief executives on where they plan to invest, which informs investor sentiment about national economies.

nfafa1515cd.headline: Brazil's Oil Exports at Risk as U.S. Shifts Energy Policy
nfafa1515cd.summary: Brazil's oil exports are at risk as US energy policy shifts, following Trump's national energy emergency announced on January 20, 2025, according to The Rio Times.
nfafa1515cd.why: Brazil is a significant crude oil producer, and changes in US energy policy can alter global supply and demand balances for crude.

nf8e34e63db.headline: Speculators eye soybeans as corn market heats up - Invezz
nf8e34e63db.summary: Speculators are looking at soybeans as activity heats up in the corn market, according to an Invezz report.
nf8e34e63db.why: Soybeans and corn are major grain futures traded on the CBOT, and their prices affect farm incomes, food costs and agribusiness margins.

n6f1bdf3f6d.headline: Stock market today: Dow gains 500 points, stocks close near records as Trump holds off on tariffs
n6f1bdf3f6d.summary: The Dow rose about 500 points and stocks closed near records as Trump held off on tariffs. Investors are assessing the likely impact of his policy.
n6f1bdf3f6d.why: The Dow Jones Industrial Average tracks 30 large US companies and is a widely watched gauge of US equity market sentiment.
n6f1bdf3f6d.why_moved: Trump holding off on tariffs eased trade concerns, and the headline says stocks closed near records.

n6bdd265eef.headline: I’m committed to serving with humility and integrity – Ato Forson
n6bdd265eef.summary: Dr Cassiel Ato Forson, newly approved as Ghana's Finance Minister, expressed gratitude and outlined his vision for the nation's financial future. He pledged to serve with humility and integrity.
n6bdd265eef.why: The finance minister leads fiscal policy, budgeting and debt management, which shape sovereign credit and investor confidence in Ghana.

n4d07e13d13.headline: Why is Trump threatening India, other BRICS nations with 100% tariffs? - Invezz
n4d07e13d13.summary: Invezz reports that US President Donald Trump has threatened India and other BRICS nations with 100% tariffs. The article questions the rationale behind the threat.
n4d07e13d13.why: The BRICS bloc includes major emerging economies whose exports to the United States could be heavily affected by tariffs, influencing global trade flows.

n36a1ad2060.headline: MIIF Gold Trade Programme - A multi-billion-dollar opportunity For Ghana
n36a1ad2060.summary: Allegations of losses and impropriety have been raised about the gold-for-oil programme started by the previous government with the Bank of Ghana and the Minerals Income Investment Fund. The fund is at the centre of the accusations.
n36a1ad2060.why: The Minerals Income Investment Fund is Ghana's state vehicle for monetising mineral resources, and the programme affects public finances and gold-linked trade.

n658e6ada3b.headline: Ghana's cocoa production hits 20-year low, Minister-Designate Reveals.
n658e6ada3b.summary: Ghana's cocoa production has fallen to its lowest level in two decades, with output at about 530,000 tonnes, according to the minister-designate.
n658e6ada3b.why: Ghana is one of the world's largest cocoa producers, so its output levels influence global cocoa supply and prices that feed into chocolate makers' costs.

nbd95811907.headline: Forestar Group:  Fiscal Q1 Earnings Snapshot
nbd95811907.summary: Forestar Group Inc. reported earnings of $16.5 million in its fiscal first quarter, according to MarketScreener. The Arlington, Texas-based company reports on a per-share basis.
nbd95811907.why: Forestar is a US residential lot developer, so its results offer a read on demand for developed housing lots.

nc8d3481b3f.headline: Morning Bid:
nc8d3481b3f.summary: Stock and currency markets were knocked back and forth on the first day of Donald Trump's presidency, according to Yahoo Finance's Morning Bid. The report describes it as a taste of things to come.
nc8d3481b3f.why: US stock and currency markets react to presidential policy signals on tariffs, taxes and regulation, which affect investor expectations.
nc8d3481b3f.why_moved: Markets were volatile on the first day of the new US administration, as investors reacted to the new president's early moves.

na0d14041fe.headline: North American Morning Briefing :  Stock Futures Rise As Trump Moves Back To The White House
na0d14041fe.summary: Stock futures rose and bond yields fell after President Donald Trump did not impose a range of tariffs on imported goods immediately after returning to the White House, contrary to earlier pledges.
na0d14041fe.why: Tariff policy affects trade costs, corporate earnings expectations and inflation, which drive equity and bond pricing.
na0d14041fe.why_moved: Stock futures rose and bond yields fell after Trump did not immediately impose the tariffs he had previously pledged. Lower expected trade-policy risk supports risk appetite.

n16519c9414.headline: Decline in company collapses in England and Wales in 2024
n16519c9414.summary: Some 23,872 companies went into collapse in England and Wales in 2024, with the number falling year on year. Experts warned of more uncertainty for firms in the coming months.
n16519c9414.why: Company insolvency data is a key gauge of business health and credit risk in the UK economy.

n772eb5fea5.headline: Gap’s 50th Indian store opens at Mumbai’s Phoenix Palladium mall
n772eb5fea5.summary: Gap opened its 50th store in India at the Phoenix Palladium mall in Mumbai. Reliance Retail is the official retailer for Gap across all channels in India.
n772eb5fea5.why: Gap is a US apparel retailer, and its India expansion through Reliance Retail reflects growing consumer retail demand in India.

nf8b99e9b3f.headline: Can the ICC survive the U.S. sanctions? (Part 2)
nf8b99e9b3f.summary: Forthcoming US sanctions against the International Criminal Court risk bringing the institution to a complete standstill. Experts describe how it works and the possible consequences.
nf8b99e9b3f.why: The International Criminal Court is based in The Hague and is funded by member states. Sanctions can affect banking and operational access for international institutions.

nfb35c1ef28.headline: South Korea’s Yoon denies wrongdoing at impeachment trial
nfb35c1ef28.summary: Impeached president Yoon Suk Yeol denied ordering the military to remove lawmakers during his first appearance before the Constitutional Court. The trial concerns his removal from office.
nfb35c1ef28.why: Political instability in South Korea, the world's 13th-largest economy, can weigh on the won, local equities and investor sentiment toward Korean assets.

nd51f79d551.headline: Indian Refiners Issue Crude Import Tenders Amid Squeezed Russian Supply
nd51f79d551.summary: Indian refiners are issuing crude import tenders as US sanctions on Russian oil push them to seek alternative sources. The shift is raising costs and logistical challenges.
nd51f79d551.why: India is one of the world's largest crude importers, and changes in its sourcing affect global oil flows and prices.

na0c3019ab8.headline: Trump Holds Off on Immediate China Tariffs, Calls for Study
na0c3019ab8.summary: Bloomberg reports that President Trump has held off on immediate tariffs on China and called for a study. The item is a brief Bloomberg excerpt with limited further detail.
na0c3019ab8.why: Tariffs on China affect trade flows, supply chains and corporate margins for US and global firms. Changes in trade policy are a key driver of equity and currency markets.
na0c3019ab8.why_moved: Holding off on immediate tariffs and calling for a study removes near-term escalation of US-China trade tensions.

n0d1167efa7.headline: Trump effectively pulls US out of global corporate tax deal
n0d1167efa7.summary: President Donald Trump declared on Monday that the global corporate minimum tax deal has no force or effect in the US, effectively pulling America out of the 2021 arrangement with nearly 140 countries.
n0d1167efa7.why: The global minimum tax, agreed under the OECD framework, sets a floor on corporate tax rates for multinational companies. US withdrawal affects how multinationals are taxed across borders.

nb149658385.headline: Alstom to deliver automated metro trains for Lille’s modernisation project
nb149658385.summary: Alstom will deliver 52-metre automated metro trains to replace outdated VAL-208 trainsets in Lille, with the replacement starting in 2028.
nb149658385.why: Alstom is a French rail equipment maker that builds trains and signalling systems for urban transit operators worldwide. Contract wins like this add to its order backlog.

n781a2b6e37.headline: Rupee rises 17 paise to 86.28 against US dollar in early trade
n781a2b6e37.summary: The rupee strengthened by 17 paise to 86.28 against the US dollar amid a weaker dollar index and falling crude oil prices.
n781a2b6e37.why: The rupee's exchange rate against the dollar affects India's import costs and foreign investor returns. Crude oil is a major import for India.

n42c3387085.headline: Pakistan reaches $1Billion loan deal with Middle Eastern Banks amid financial woes
n42c3387085.summary: Pakistan obtained a $1 billion loan from Middle Eastern banks at a 6-7 percent interest rate to shore up its finances, according to Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb.
n42c3387085.why: Sovereign loans from commercial lenders affect a country's external financing costs and its ability to meet debt obligations.
